name: YMCA of Metro Denver Summer Jobs for Teens
what_you_do: Work at a Y in summer. Jobs are lifeguard, swim instructor, or part-time camp counselor. Lifeguards need lifeguard certification and CPR.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard, swim instructor and aquatic jobs: age 15 or older. Part-time camp counselor: age 16 or older and some experience with kids. Full time day camp leader: age 18 or older.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The program page gives no dates. It says the Y recruits every spring.
how_to_apply: Go to the summer jobs page. To see all locations, type LIFEGUARD in the search box on that page.
notes: Lifeguards need American Red Cross or YMCA lifeguard certification and CPR-AED. The Y offers lifeguard training. It reimburses the training cost after 3 months of employment. The page does not show a year, so check the jobs search for current openings.
